anchor_statement: The sanity close hook must count FAIL rounds per sanity bead in metadata.sanity_round and, when the count reaches max_sanity_rounds from the repository configuration (default 5 when unset), must escalate to the phase lead instead of reopening the checked bead.

cases.text: sanity_round goes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5; on the fifth FAIL the hook sends the lead SANITY.ROUND_CAP and reopens nothing; max_sanity_rounds: 2 in the repo config escalates on the second.
The hook reopens the dev bead on every FAIL forever, or the cap is a constant in the script with no repository setting.

Each sanity FAIL increments metadata.sanity_round on that sanity bead; once it reaches max_sanity_rounds from the repository configuration, or 5 when the key is unset, the hook escalates to the phase lead instead of reopening the checked bead.

cases.rationale: In-scope FAIL branch, silent about counting and the cap.
cases.text: On a sanity FAIL the hook sends the dev the sanity-fail template on the open task.

cases.rationale: The cap must come from repository configuration with default 5.
cases.text: The hook escalates to the lead after a fixed three FAILs coded in the script, with no configuration key.

cases.rationale: The count must be metadata.sanity_round on the sanity bead.
